name: Atomic Super Lander Re-Nuked Edition
summary:
Asteroids are on a collision course with Earth! The government of Libertica has launched a plan to save the world! The best of the best have been gathered, and among all the volunteer candidates, you have been chosen. Your mission: land on the asteroid and plant a nuclear bomb. But what you don't know is that these seemingly lifeless asteroids are crawling with alien creatures determined to stop you! So grab your nukes, put up your fists, and get ready — because things just got real!
Atomic Super Lander Re-Nuked Edition is a blast from the past — the unreleased Windows version of a game originally launched on mobile back in 2016, under the now-discontinued BitWeird banner.
